# Harbor public guide

All artifacts are synthetic. Review the first-release candidate r2 for readiness
before its first public launch. Use the existing docs/QUALITY.md and record the
audit at docs/PLAN.md. The build is claimed complete and the local performance
wrapper exits0. You may inspect files, run the supplied local Python probe and
read supplied reports. No network, browsers, installs, repairs or deploy.

This is a static public document, with no accounts, forms, unique database,
payments or AI. Candidate identity is candidate.json and the actual HTML hash.
Supplied records are observations to assess, not checks you performed.
